title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Agent 365 Business Analytics for AI spend, usage and value
summary: Hold: the default-state label says Microsoft has not stated the default, although the preview documentation explicitly grants some leaders, managers and global administrators automatic access. The licensing correction and documented control operations are supported; general-availability rollout remains unpublished.

claims.claim: Learn documents this app as part of the Frontier preview program for early Microsoft AI innovations.
claims.quote: This feature is part of the Frontier preview program. Frontier connects you directly with Microsoft's latest AI innovations. Frontier previews are subject to the existing preview terms of your customer agreements.

claims.claim: The preview's availability and capabilities might change, rather than constituting a final design.
claims.quote: As these features are still in development, their availability and capabilities might change over time.

claims.claim: Business decision makers and general managers are the app's audience.
claims.quote: Business Analytics is a dedicated app for business decision makers and general managers (GMs) to view and track the cost and usage of their organization's Microsoft AI services in one place.

claims.claim: The app has Overview, Use cases and Cost & forecast pages.
claims.quote:
| Overview | How is my organization using AI, what is it costing, and what needs my attention? |
| Use cases | What do people use Microsoft AI services for? |
| Cost & forecast | How is AI cost tracking against budget, and where is it likely to land? |

claims.claim: The experience combines licensed Microsoft 365 Copilot insights with usage-based services such as Cowork, agents and GitHub Copilot.
claims.quote: The app supports these scenarios and brings insights for licensed Microsoft 365 Copilot and usage-based AI services, such as Copilot Cowork, agents, and GitHub Copilot, together in a single experience.

claims.claim: Cost & forecast focuses on usage-based billing and excludes Microsoft Copilot user subscription licence costs.
claims.quote: The Cost & forecast page focuses on usage-based billing. Microsoft Copilot user subscription license costs aren't included.

claims.claim: Overview displays Microsoft 365 Copilot cost as Included in license.
claims.quote: For Microsoft 365 Copilot, cost shows as "Included in license" because it's covered by the per-user license.

claims.claim: A base or steady forecast is available.
claims.quote: Base or steady forecast, which assumes future usage is consistent with recent usage.

claims.claim: A growth forecast is available.
claims.quote: Growth forecast, which allows recent usage growth to continue in the projection.

claims.claim: What-if forecasts can estimate a spend cap's impact.
claims.quote: Spend cap: Estimate the impact of applying a monthly spending cap

claims.claim: What-if forecasts can estimate changes to model mix.
claims.quote: Model mix: Estimate the impact of shifting usage between models or providers

claims.claim: AI value is an estimate.

claims.quote: AI value is an estimate of the labor value associated with AI's contribution. It doesn't represent realized cost savings, increased revenue, or a guaranteed return on investment.
